decisions.reason: This desk system builds directly on our office furniture know-how, was given dedicated market presentation, and fits our R&D-backed ability to refine ergonomic and flexible workplace solutions.
The chair family is closely related to our established seating and interior competence, so we can readily learn from early market feedback and improve it commercially.
These floor cushions extend our existing material and interior-solution capabilities into a related lounge accessory, making them a manageable adjacent innovation worth developing further.

Although the sofa was only mentioned rather than fully highlighted, it is still close to our upholstery and lounge expertise, so our existing knowledge base gives us a good chance to improve its market position.
The high standing table is closely connected to our established workplace offer and current demand for adaptable office environments, so it fits both our knowledge base and strategic direction.

The rug collection is the most distant from our core furniture and upholstery knowledge, and without stronger evidence of traction it would stretch absorptive capacity and development resources too far.
